NONE: › to criticize or complain often in an annoying way
不斷批評（或抱怨）；跟…糾纏不休；嘮叨
› a horse, especially one that is too old to be useful

example: [ + obj + to infinitive ] My mum's always nagging me to get my hair cut.
我媽媽總是嘮叨著要我去理髮。
If you stop nagging at me, I might actually do it.
如果你不再煩我，我或許真的就做了。

NONE: › If doubts or worries nag (away) at you, you think about them all the time.
（疑慮或擔心）不斷困擾，不斷煩擾（某人）

example: The same thought has been nagging away at me since last week.
自從上週開始，同樣的想法就一直困擾著我。

NONE: › used to describe an unpleasant feeling that continues for a long period of time
令人心煩不已的；糾纏不休的

example: I got sick of her constant nagging.
我對她沒完沒了的抱怨感到厭煩。
